title: The Orbit of the Kuiper Line
author: Ansel Pemberton
blurb: Orsen Thornbury, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
